oss.readme:
# VIctory

Runs Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series X|S) natively on Windows, from files
the user supplies.

The title's x86-64 code runs unchanged inside our process; VIctory supplies
the platform underneath it and converts the title's data, ahead of time where
it can (shaders and pipelines too, see Getting started) and on first use
otherwise. See [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

## Status (2026-11-24)

**Not playable yet.** The title boots, runs its menus at its own 30 fps,
loads the world and shows it: slowly, and with rendering defects.

| Stage | State |
|-------|-------|
| Boot, first-boot screens (accessibility, language, settings, legal) | works, 30 fps |
| Intro video with sound | works |
| Start screen, profile and saves | works |
| Loading into the world (about 50 s) | works |
| The world (first mission's intro) | drawn and shown: streets, buildings, vehicles, characters, the title card and credits; 1-2 s per frame. Surfaces are unlit, a band of distant geometry is missing, characters come out broken in some shots |

Tested on one machine: Windows 11, AMD RX 6700 XT.

> **Warning.** Entering the world on a real GPU has hung it in earlier
> builds, and Windows then resets the display driver (every monitor goes
> black for a moment). The latest runs did not, but it is not ruled out; a
> run can also end on a GPU fault (`crashes.log`). A diagnostics build with
> `VICTORY_D3D12_WARP=1` renders on the software adapter instead (too slow
> to reach the world in minutes).

What each part does today and what it still needs:

| Subsystem | Today | Needs |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| Loader | Runs the title's executable and its DLLs in our process; crash reports name the faulting code and are kept in `crashes.log` | – |
| Runtime services | One signed-in offline user, licences, packages, saves that survive a kill at any step, text entry dialog | Speech is silent; the dialog and relaunch are untested live |
| Network | Offline by design: the title cannot reach the network | – |
| Files and streaming | Archives and streamed data read, zlib and BCPack decoded in parallel | Loading is limited by writes into title memory |
| Input | XInput pads, keyboard, keyboard stand-in pad | Trigger rumble |
| Audio | Menu, video and loading sound; XMA voices and Opus streams decode | Reverb is silent; Opus results unverified against the title |
| GPU: menus | Draws, compute and presentation on host D3D12; only changed title memory is copied | Frame pacing drifts on one screen in release builds |
| GPU: world | The scene is drawn and presented: mesh pipelines, indirect execution, views the shaders pick from the heap themselves, title memory read by address (ray-tracing structures), depth written from compute, pipelines pre-built or made by worker threads and kept on disk | Lighting (surfaces are unlit) and some missing geometry; frames take 1-2 s; draws of untranslated shaders are dropped; real queries, depth bounds, HDR and scaling are missing |
| Shaders | Console GPU code recompiled to DXIL, ahead of time (`translate --cache`) or at first use, cached on disk. Menus: all. World: mesh 8,765 of 8,765, vertex/pixel 12,550 of 12,592, compute 2,579 of 2,637 | Merged geometry stages (195 programs) and about 100 others; fused multiply-adds follow the host GPU; some compute programs need a GPU with 64-lane waves |
| Textures | Console tiled layouts and detiling for the modes the title uses | Render-target metadata planes |
| Series S mode | Runs through the menus to the loading screen | The world, as above |

## Getting started

Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, a CPU with AVX2, a Direct3D 12 GPU with
shader model 6.6 (and mesh shaders for the world), Rust (pinned in
`rust-toolchain.toml`).

The title also needs several GiB of available Windows commit at startup.
Check **Committed** under **Task Manager → Performance → Memory**. If
`crashes.log` reports Windows error 1455, close other applications or increase
the Windows paging file size, then retry.

```powershell
cargo xtask install-hooks                # asset-policy check on every commit
copy victory.example.toml victory.toml   # then set your paths (outside the repo)
cargo test --workspace                   # needs no game data
cargo run -p victory -- config           # check your paths
```

Run the title:

```powershell
cargo build --release -p victory
target\release\victory.exe translate --cache --pipelines \shaders.rpf \ \XboxBvhBuilder.dll \amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_xbox.dll
target\release\victory.exe run \ --execute
```

The `translate --cache` step (minutes; again after a change of the shader
translator) translates every shader the title can ask for into the cache
(about 1.3 GB), so a run does not translate them while it plays; without it
they are translated at first use, and their draws wait. With `--pipelines`
it then makes every pipeline in the title's shader pack (inside
`shaders.rpf`) into the host pipeline library (about 27,000 pipelines, 4 MB;
some 20 minutes on 16 threads, most of it the 2,700 compute ones), so a run
compiles none of those either; the library belongs to the GPU and driver it
was made on. Run again, it skips what is there in seconds; stopped
early, it keeps what it made.

Upscaling (Series S mode): the title upscales with AMD FidelityFX. To run
it with the PC build on your GPU instead of the console build, get the
[FidelityFX SDK](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK)
and point `VICTORY_FIDELITYFX_DIR` (or `[paths].fidelityfx_dir`) at its
`Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin` folder, which holds
`amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_dx12.dll`. Without it, or if that DLL offers no
upscaler for your GPU (the log says so), the title's own DLLs run.

The window caption shows the framerate. Saves, settings and `crashes.log`
are kept under the data folder (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\victory\data`), derived
data under the cache folder.

oss.readme:
# XCL – Xbox Series X|S → Windows compatibility layer

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join%20the%20server-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xcl)
**Discord: **

XCL is a compatibility layer that runs Xbox Series X|S (GDK) games you own on a Windows PC - in the spirit of Wine/Proton. There is no CPU emulation: the game's x64 code runs natively, and XCL provides its own, independently written implementations of the console system libraries the PC does not have (`kernelx.dll`, XGameRuntime, `d3d12_xs.dll`, …). The console's GPU code (RDNA2 machine code) is recompiled into PC shaders (HLSL → DXIL).

XCL works only on unpacked game files you already own. It does not download, decrypt or unpack game packages (XVC / MSIXVC) and contains nothing for circumventing DRM. The repository holds no code, headers or binaries from the console SDK, no keys and no game data; the Windows components XCL relies on (XGameRuntime, XAudio2, D3D12, DXC) come from your own system or the public Windows SDK and are not distributed with XCL.

## Games

| Game | Package (version) | State | What works | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Minecraft Preview** | `Microsoft.MinecraftBeta` 1.18.3064.0 | ✅ | fully playable | – |
| **Unicorn Overlord** | `SEGAofAmericaInc.Pa253b0c1Y` 1.0.0.6 | ✅ | fully playable | – |
| **Fortnite** | `436609B6.FortniteClient` 2.0.1461.7919 | ✅ | works fully, as far as the game allows without its online services | the game itself is online-only (multiplayer servers) |
| **XDefiant** | `Ubisoft.XDefiant-Game` 1.0.0.186 | ✅ | works fully, as far as the game allows without its servers | the game's own servers have been shut down |
| **A newer retail game** | – | 🚧 | starts in ~4 s, runs at a steady 30 fps without a crash, shows its menus and goes on past the first one to its settings; fits a 32 GB machine (~15 GB committed in the menus) | gameplay not reached yet; its minimap mesh pipelines are refused |

## Highlights

- **100 % of a retail game's shaders translate** – all 26 698 RDNA2 programs (26 503 records) of its shader pack
  become HLSL; random samples compile to DXIL with 0 errors.
- **The game's own console DLLs run on the PC** – its Bink 2 video codec decodes the game's
  movies, its ray-tracing BVH builder builds acceleration structures on a PC GPU, the AMD FSR 4
  console upscaler runs a whole frame on a PC GPU, the GDK HTTP library initialises.
- **Console textures decode exactly** – the GFX10 tiling and mip layout reproduce 909 of 912
  textures of the game's texture archive byte for byte, its volume textures included.
- **370+ automated tests**, including GPU tests that compare translated shaders against expected
  results instruction by instruction.

## What works

✅ done and verified

### Running the game's code

| Feature | State | What it does | Verified by |
|---|---|---|---|
| **PE loader** | ✅ | relocations, imports by name / ordinal / delay-load, TLS callbacks, exception tables, game DLLs, data-driven import routing (HLE / Windows / stub) | the game's 16 console DLLs load with 0 unresolved imports |
| **kernelx** | ✅ | title memory (budget from MicrosoftGame.Config, physical pages), threads on the PC's processors, modules, OS / console info | unit + end-to-end tests |
| **Memory** | ✅ | title graphics memory shared by CPU and GPU without copies, up to 16 GB (4 GiB windows) | GPU tests: loads, stores and atomics across windows |
| **File system** | ✅ | console paths (`GAME:`, `G:`, `D:` …) → the game folder; writes go to an overlay, the game folder is never modified; the console's drives: `S:\` (persistent local storage) and `T:\` (temp) in the title's data folder; free disk space answered for console paths | end-to-end: the test title's folder stays byte-identical; PLS and free space through the real call path |
| **DirectStorage** | ✅ | the console's DirectStorage queues: file and memory sources, zlib, and BCPack – the console's texture compression – for BC1, BC3, BC4, BC5, BC6H and BC7 (BC2 and the hardware swizzle are refused) | unit tests on synthetic streams; retail BCPack chunks of all six modes byte-identical with a reference decoder (`XCL_SAMPLE_BCPACK`) |

### System services

| Feature | State | What it does | Verified by |
|---|---|---|---|
| **XGameRuntime** | ✅ | the GDK thunk protocol real titles use, laid out from a table of all 396 GDK runtime functions; offline XUser, XGameSave, persistent local storage, XPackage, XGame (title id), XSystem – the title sees an Xbox Series X / S; task queues, async, networking and dialogs through the PC's XGameRuntime | the game's libHttpClient initialises; users, saves and storage through the real call path; slot layout cross-checked against the game's own thunks |
| **Input** | ✅ | GameInput: one gamepad – the PC's XInput controller, and keyboard and mouse as a gamepad (see [Controls](#controls)) | unit tests; an Xbox controller in Minecraft |
| **Audio** | ✅ | XAudio2 → system XAudio2.9 (PCM / float voices; Opus 0x704F decoded via `MSOpusDecoder.dll`; XMA1 / XMA2 decoded in pure Rust) | unit + end-to-end tests |

oss.description: XNU as a loadable kernel module inside Linux (macOS personality for arm64 Linux)
oss.readme:
# xnulinux

Run macOS userspace on Linux by loading the macOS kernel into it.

xnulinux builds XNU, the open-source kernel of macOS, from Apple's published sources and runs it as a loadable kernel
module (`xnu.ko`) inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel. The hosted XNU drives the CPU and MMU directly, so macOS
processes run natively next to Linux processes on the same CPUs, with no hypervisor between them. Linux lends XNU its
memory, timers, files, network and GPU through a small interface module (`fki.ko`).

With a stock Ubuntu kernel, `insmod xnu.ko` boots a macOS 27 system disk made by Apple's own installer to the
desktop: loginwindow, WindowServer, Dock, Finder, Safari and Chrome.

![macOS and Linux userspace side by side](docs/images/macos-and-linux.jpg)

*One system, two userspaces. Left: a Terminal in the hosted macOS 27.2.1 (`sw_vers`, the Darwin kernel, launchd,
WindowServer, Dock and Finder running). Right: from that macOS, an SSH session into the Linux it runs inside (Ubuntu,
Linux 7.0, the `xnu` and `fki` modules loaded, and the `insmod xnu.ko` process the macOS kernel runs in).
Straight from the hosted framebuffer, 1280×800.*

![The hosted macOS desktop](docs/images/desktop.jpg)

*The hosted desktop at the end of a 30-minute stress run, rendered on the CPU (no GPU bridge).*

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Safari on Wikipedia's XNU article](docs/images/safari-xnu.jpg) | ![Safari on kernel.org](docs/images/safari-kernel-org.jpg) |
| ![Safari on GitHub](docs/images/safari-github.jpg) | |

*Safari in the hosted macOS: Wikipedia's article on XNU, kernel.org and the Linux repository on GitHub, over the
hosted system's network link through Linux, with the GPU bridge on (`GPU=auto`).*

![Hosted macOS running on bare-metal NVIDIA DGX Spark](docs/images/dgx-spark.jpg)

*Bare-metal NVIDIA DGX Spark (Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS aarch64, Linux `7.0.0-1025-nvidia`): hosted macOS 27 running with
4 CPUs and 8 GiB of RAM (CPU rendering), shown over macOS Screen Sharing alongside an SSH session from the DGX Spark
host into the hosted Darwin userspace.*

![About This Mac and sysctl on bare-metal NVIDIA DGX Spark](docs/images/dgx-spark-about.jpg)

*Inside the hosted macOS on DGX Spark: About This Mac (`Chip: Unknown`, `7.80 GB` memory, `macOS Golden Gate 27.2`)
alongside `sysctl machdep.cpu` (`ARM processor`, `hw.cpufamily: 0`, `hw.ncpu: 4`) and `hw.optional.arm`.*

## How it works

```
 macOS processes (launchd, WindowServer, Safari...)    Linux processes (systemd, sshd, xnudrmd...)
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────    ────────────────────────────────────────────
 XNU (source-built, LINUX64 machine layer, kexts)  │
   ↕ linux64 host calls (xnu-patches/include/linux64_abi.h)
 xnu.ko   (APSL side: loads and runs the kernel collection)
   ↕ FKI, the foreign kernel interface (fki_*)
 fki.ko   (GPL side: CPUs, memory, faults, IPIs, files, network, host calls)
 Linux kernel (stock distro kernel, 4K pages, PAC)
```

- **CPUs**: each hosted CPU is a Linux kernel thread pinned to a Linux CPU. XNU runs on it until it calls the host
  (idle, I/O, a timer); Linux keeps its own exception vectors, and `fki.ko` forwards the faults and user exceptions of
  XNU code to XNU's handlers.
- **Memory**: XNU gets one physically contiguous block from Linux (CMA) and manages it with its own pmap; XNU and Linux
  share the user half of the address space layout (4K pages).
- **Devices**: kexts in `kexts/` give macOS a disk (a file on the Linux side), a display (a framebuffer Linux reads), a
  keyboard and pointer, an Ethernet link (a Linux network interface), a keystore and a GPU bridge.
- **GPU**: Metal in the hosted macOS runs on `gpu/xnu-cpu-metal` (metal2vulkan over Vulkan). Vulkan reaches the Linux
  host's GPU through the DRM bridge (`kexts/XnuDrm` → host call → `gpu/xnu-drm/xnudrmd` → the Linux render node), using
  Mesa's Venus driver; without a supported DRM bridge backend it falls back to Mesa lavapipe on the CPU.

## Status

Working on two arm64 Linux setups:

- **Apple Silicon Mac in an arm64 Linux VM (`krunkit`, 1 to 6 hosted CPUs)**:
  - macOS 27.2.1 boots to the desktop with auto-login in 31–48 s (an Apple Virtualization macOS VM on the same Mac:
    49 s).
  - Apps open and quit, Spotlight and the file system work; a 30-minute stress run (40 rounds of Safari, Notes,
    Calculator, TextEdit, System Settings, Spotlight and a disk walk) finishes with no panic and no crash report.
  - Runs as a systemd service: started at boot, stopped cleanly with the VM, restarted after a hosted-kernel panic, each
    run's log kept in `/var/log/xnulinux/`.
  - The GPU bridge gives hosted apps the host GPU (`Virtio-GPU Venus (Apple M5 Max)`) and is enabled by default
    (`GPU=auto`) when a virtio-gpu render node is present, falling back to CPU rendering (`GPU=off`) otherwise.
- **Bare-metal NVIDIA DGX Spark (Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS aarch64, Linux `7.0.0-1025-nvidia`)**:
  - Boots to the full macOS desktop (Screen Sharing and SSH working) directly on bare-metal arm64 Linux with `CPUS=4`
    and 8 GiB of RAM reserved for XNU.
  - Currently renders on the CPU (Mesa lavapipe, `GPU=off`): `xnudrmd` only forwards `virtio-gpu` (Venus) ioctls today,
    so hardware GPU pass-through on the GB10 GPU requires a new DRM bridge backend.

What is still a stopgap is listed in [`docs/production.md`](docs/production.md). Notably: the OS cryptex is merged into
the system volume, AMFI is patched and SIP relaxed, and memory access is slower than a native VM (4K pages vs 16K).

## Requirements

- An arm64 Linux host with PAC (`FEAT_PAuth`), 4K pages, and at least 16 GB of RAM (8 GB reserved for the hosted
  kernel). Tested on:
  - **NVIDIA DGX Spark** (bare-metal Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS aarch64, Linux `7.0.0-1025-nvidia`; CPU rendering for now).
  - **Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later)** running an arm64 Linux VM (`krunkit` for GPU access via virtio-gpu Venus, or
    `tart`).
- A Mac with Xcode to make the system disk and build the GPU parts.
- A macOS 27

# ung220z-tool

光猫（ONT）凭据自查工具箱：**UNG220Z 一键提取**，另含多厂商适配包 `ontkit`
（中兴 / 烽火 / 华为 / 九联），以及固件指纹识别与分家族排障建议。

支持机型与验证状态见 [机型兼容性](#机型兼容性)，其中只有 UNG220Z 经过真机验证。

> ⚠️ 仅用于**你自己的设备**，用于找回自己忘记的管理密码、迁移宽带配置或安全自查。
> 未经授权对他人设备使用属于违法行为，作者不承担任何责任。

## 背景

这类光猫的 Web 管理页基于 `.gch` CGI 框架，登录口令由 TR-069 定期轮换，普通用户拿到的密码往往几天就失效。本工具走 Telnet 通道，直接读取设备配置库，拿到**当下有效**的全部凭据。

## 目录结构

```
ung220z.py          # 主脚本：UNG220Z 一键提权 + 提凭据
ontkit/             # 多厂商适配包
├── cli.py          #   probe / zte / huawei 三个子命令
├── zte_factory.py  #   中兴 webFac 工厂模式（AES-ECB 协议）
├── zte_web.py      #   中兴 .gch 登录、配置解密、凭据提取
├── huawei.py       #   华为 ssmp 登录、开 Telnet（实验性）
└── core.py         #   HTTP 会话 + Telnet 客户端
models/             # 按型号的入口脚本（自动补默认端口）
├── ung853h.py  h3_2.py  g7615.py  hs8145x6.py  b866l1.py
```

## 工作流程

```
用户输入账号密码
   ↓
拼出 http:///usr=&psw=&cmd=1&telnet.gch 并打开浏览器（同时脚本直连兜底）
   ↓
Telnet 登录 → root shell
   ↓
sidbg 1 DB decry /userconfig/cfg/db_user_cfg.xml 解密配置
   ↓
提取 Web 账号 / Telnet 口令 / PPPoE / WiFi 密钥 / root 口令
   ↓
打印凭据表 + 落盘日志
```

## 用法

```bash
python3 ung220z.py
```

会依次询问：

```
※ 用户名和密码通常印在光猫【背面贴纸】上（S/N 标签）
  形如「用户名：user   密码：xxxxxxxx」，把光猫翻过来就能看到

① 光猫地址 [192.168.1.1]:
② 用户名 [user]:
③ 密码（输入时不显示）
   密码:
```

也可以全部走命令行：

```bash
python3 ung220z.py -i 192.168.1.1 -u user -p '你的密码'
python3 ung220z.py -i 192.168.1.1 -u user -p '你的密码' --no-browser
```

### 常用参数

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `-i, --ip` | 光猫地址，默认 `192.168.1.1` |
| `-u, --user` | 登录用户名，默认 `user` |
| `-p, --password` | 登录密码，不填则交互输入 |
| `--telnet-user` | Telnet 用户名，默认 `CMCCAdmin` |
| `--telnet-password` | Telnet 口令（部分机型与 Web 口令不同） |
| `--no-browser` | 不调用浏览器，纯 HTTP 请求 |
| `--unlock` | Web 被会话锁占住时重启 httpd 解锁 |
| `--no-release` | 不尝试释放残留 Web 会话 |
| `--telnet-port` | Telnet 端口，默认 23 |
| `--timeout` | 网络超时秒数，默认 8 |

## 输出示例

```
[22:15:00] INFO   会话开始  目标=192.168.1.1  账户=user
[22:15:00] HTTP   已发送给浏览器: http://192.168.1.1/usr=user&psw=***&cmd=1&telnet.gch
[22:15:00] HTTP   telnet.gch → TelnetSet Success!
[22:15:00] PROBE  nc -zv 192.168.1.1 23 → succeeded
[22:15:01] AUTH   Telnet CMCCAdmin / ****** → 登录成功（root）
[22:15:02] SHELL  sidbg 1 DB decry /userconfig/cfg/db_user_cfg.xml → /tmp/debug-decry-cfg
[22:15:03] DATA   DevAuthInfo  CMCCAdmin  / ******  Level=1
[22:15:04] CRACK  MATCH: ******  (/etc/shadow)
```

最后输出凭据汇总表，并写入 `ung220z_.log`。

## 依赖

- Python 3.8+
- 标准库即可，无需 pip 安装
- 设备已开启 Telnet（脚本会自动通过 `telnet.gch` 尝试开启）

## 原理说明

| 环节 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 开 Telnet | `GET /usr=&psw=&cmd=1&telnet.gch`，返回 `TelnetSet Success!` 即成功 |
| Web 登录 | 密码前端只做 base64，`Frm_Logintoken` 每次响应递增，必须回填实时值 |
| 配置解密 | `sidbg 1 DB decry` 无口令即可解密，得到明文 XML |
| root 口令 | `/etc/shadow` 中为 SHA-256 crypt，工具会用常见出厂口令比对 |

## 多厂商支持（ontkit）

主脚本只针对九联 `.gch` 体系。遇到其他固件时用 `ontkit`：

```bash
# 先识别固件家族
python3 -m ontkit probe -H 192.168.1.1

# 中兴系（G7615 / UNG853H / 吉比特等）：走 webFac 工厂模式开 Telnet
python3 -m ontkit zte -H 192.168.1.1 -p 8080 --mode factory --enable-telnet

# 华为系（HS8145X6 / B866-L1 等）
python3 -m ontkit huawei -H 192.168.1.1
```

按型号直接跑：

```bash
python3 models/g7615.py    -H 192.168.1.1 --mode factory
python3 models/ung853h.py  -H 192.168.1.1 -u user -P '贴纸密码' --extract
```

各型号的验证状态见 [ontkit/README.md](ontkit/README.md)：webFac 协议按公开实现移植并已自测，
其余型号未经真机验证。

## 排障

### `telnet.gch` 返回 404

说明该固件没有这个接口，**不是九联/吉比特的 `.gch` 体系**，本脚本的开启方式不适用。
脚本会打印设备指纹（`Server` 头 + 页面标题）帮助判断。下一步：

```bash
python3 -m ontkit probe -H 192.168.1.1          # 识别固件家族
python3 -m ontkit zte   -H 192.168.1.1 -p 8080  # 中兴系（webFac 工厂模式）
python3 -m ontkit huawei -H 192.168.1.1         # 华为系（ssmp）
```

### `telnet.gch` 成功但 23 端口未监听

- 设备可能在 Web 后台把 Telnet 服务关闭了，只留了开关接口
- 也可能需要几秒才起监听，等一下重试

### Telnet 能连上但登录被拒

Telnet 与 Web 是**两套账号库**。脚本会依次尝试：

1. 你填的 Web 账号（如 `useradmin`）
2. `CMCCAdmin` + 同一口令
3. `--telnet-password` 指定值
4. Web 侧侦察：`manager_aduser_conf_t.gch&IF_INDEX=0` 读管理员行 → 用其口令登录 → `tele_sec_tserver_t.gch` 取 `TS_UPwd`
5. 出厂默认组合

也可以手动在浏览器（已登录状态）打开：

```
http:///getpage.gch?pid=1002&nextpage=tele_sec_tserver_t.gch
```

页面源码里 `TS_UName` / `TS_UPwd` 就是 Telnet 账号密码。

### 登录失败次数超限

设备通常 3 次失败进入延时校验，**停止重试**，静默等待 10~30 分钟。

## 修复记录

### v1.2

| 问题 | 修复 |
|---|---|
| 口令含 `%` 时 URL 被当成非法转义，服务器返回 400 | 检测 `% & # ? + 空格`，优先发送百分号编码版（`aDm8H%MdA` → `aDm8H%25MdA`） |
| 缺少烽火（FiberHome）支持 | 新增 `ontkit fiberhome` + `models/hg6042a1.py`，用 MAC 开 Telnet 并读 `show admin_pwd` |

### v1.1（合并社区反馈）

| 问题 | 影响 | 修复 |
|---|---|---|
| `ls` 的 stderr 也落在 pty 上 | 解密失败被判成功，最后打印一张空凭据表 | 改用 `test -s && echo __OK__` 判定 |
| `sed` 区间在单行 XML 上失效 | 所有表混在一起，PPPoE/WiFi 被当成 Web 账号 | 新增 `Cfg` 类，整份 `cat` 一次后本地按 `` 切表（顺带把 6 次往返压成 1 次） |
| Web 页为 GBK 时解码失败 | `其他用户` 匹配不到，`--unlock` 形同虚设 | `_decode` 优先取响应头 charset，再 utf-8→gbk→gb18030 回退 |
| 无 try/finally | 断线时裸 traceback，设备上残留明文配置 | `finally` 中 `rm -f /tmp/debug-decry-cfg`、关闭 Telnet 与日志；日志文件 0600 |
| 口令 `.strip()` | 首尾空格是口令一部分时被改坏 | 改为 `rstrip("\r\n")` |
| URL 明文写日志 | 口令泄漏到日志文件 | 日志中 `psw=***` |
| 固定 marker `__X__` | 配置内容恰好包含该串时输出被截断 | 每次随机 marker |
| `IAC IAC` 未处理 | 吃掉一个 0xFF 字节 | 按 telnet 规范输出字面量 |
| 缺 openssl 时静默 | root 比对无声失败 | 明确提示 |

退出码语义：`0` 成功 / `1` 参数或异常 / `2` 网关不可达 / `3` Telnet 端口未开 / `4` 登录失败 / `5` 配置解密失败 / `130` 用户中断。

## 致谢

这个工具的可靠性，很大程度上来自各位使用者愿意花时间把失败日志贴出来。
感谢每一位提交 issue、PR 的朋友：

  同时补上了异常清理、口令边界处理、日志脱敏等改进。原始补丁见

## How it works

Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps,
asking you in plain words when a decision is yours:

1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs.
2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your
   request names (or a sensible default).
3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet.
4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

  
    
      
      Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
    
    
      
      Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
    
  

## Two ways to use it

- **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it,
  press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the
  agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and
  buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom.
  "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode).
- **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C,
  disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console.

Both modes drive the same engine.

## Clean room or Deep

- **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page
  source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor
  sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened)
  and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused
  and say how to turn on Deep mode.
- **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the
  built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start
  page watched, and the builder may use all of them.

Clean room is a rule about what Craft Anything offers and refuses. It is not an operating-system
sandbox: it doesn't isolate your computer. A coding agent you run still acts as you, and what it can
read, write or run depends on its own permissions. Which of an agent's own tools Craft Anything can
refuse differs by agent; for Claude Code's tools in chats and questions, see
[`docs/claude-code.md`](docs/claude-code.md).

Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with
`--deep` (or `--clean-room`).

  
  
  Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI

Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft
Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything
never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with

exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. **GitHub Copilot** can use your installed
Copilot CLI through ACP: sign in separately with `copilot login`. **Grok Build** can use your
installed `grok` program through ACP (`grok agent stdio`): sign in separately with `grok login`.
See [docs/grok.md](docs/grok.md). **Kimi Code CLI** can use your installed `kimi` program through
ACP (`kimi acp`): sign in separately with `kimi login`; it hasn't been run live yet. Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI,
Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki, Devin) can be switched to it per backend; of those, Maki
and Devin have been run live (Devin authenticates with the backend's stored key — its own CLI
sign-in doesn't count over ACP). Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI (Grok, when `XAI_API_KEY` is
set) and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI).

   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点（姿势与配方节点内置 `use_depth` 深度图切换，可直接接入 ControlNet Depth）与内置的 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式、卡片内多角度切换，以及 **`[ 素体白模 | 深度图 (Depth) ]` 一键切换预览与下载**。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势，姿势槽位内置 `[ 白模 | 深度 ]` 实时切换）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：
  - **Google Gemini**：`gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`、`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image`（支持宽高比 `aspectRatio`、分辨率 `1K/2K/4K`）
  - **OpenAI GPT Image**：`gpt-image-2.5`、`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-1.5`、`gpt-image-1`（支持 `/v1/images/edits` JSON URL 直传 / Multipart 上传、尺寸、质量、背景透明度）
  - **阿里云百炼 Qwen**：`qwen-image-3.0-pro`、`qwen-image-2.1-pro`、`qwen-image-2.0-pro`、`qwen-image-edit-plus`（支持 `multimodal-generation` 多图参考输入、智能改写 `prompt_extend`、水印开关）
  - **字节火山方舟 Doubao**：`doubao-seedream-5-0`、`doubao-seedream-4-5-251128`、`doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`、`doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628`（支持多图融合 `image: [...]`、2K/4K 分辨率）
  - **本地 ComfyUI 工作流引擎**：支持自动将三合一拼图及单张人像/服装/姿势图上传至本地 ComfyUI（`/upload/image`），注入自定义 API 工作流占位符或自动识别节点提交 `/prompt` 队列并轮询取回成品图；支持导入/导出通用 `.api.json` 工作流模板。
- **跨页面后台生图 & IndexedDB 历史记录**：切换页面不会中断正在进行的生图请求；生成结果自动存入浏览器 IndexedDB（避免 `localStorage` 容量限制），支持复用提示词与原图下载。

> 本地 ComfyUI 三图合成（Qwen Image Edit 2509）的模型清单、工作流说明和本地运行方法见 [docs/comfyui-local.md](docs/comfyui-local.md)。

> 导入 API 后的动态高级参数、设定集参考上传与可选显示声明见 [ComfyUI 工作流高级参数](docs/comfyui-workflow-parameters.md)。

> WebSocket 实时进度、HTTP 保底与刷新恢复见 [ComfyUI 任务连接与恢复](docs/comfyui-task-tracking.md)。

### 3. ComfyUI 原生自定义节点插件（`comfyui_plugin/`）
将本仓库克隆到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ai-pose-gallery-zh` 后，ComfyUI 画布右键菜单 **「AI角色三合一参考图集」** 下自动提供 4 个节点：
- **AI 姿势参考图 (`PoseGalleryNode`)**：输出 `姿势图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`姿势提示词`（支持 `use_depth` 开关一键切换输出素体白模或深度图）
- **AI 服装参考图 (`CostumeGalleryNode`)**：输出 `服装图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`中文服装描述`、`英文服装Prompt`
- **AI 人像参考图 (`PortraitGalleryNode`)**：输出 `人像图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`人像发型描述`
- **AI 角色三合一合成配方 (`CharacterRecipeNode`)**：单节点同时输出 `人像图`、`服装图`、`姿势图（支持 use_depth 深度图切换）`、`三合一拼图` 以及自动组装的 `中文合成Prompt` 与 `英文合成Prompt`，并内置 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器（含 🌗 深度图预览开关）**与节点内实时缩略图预览。

releases.name: wrangler@4.168.0
releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#16680](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16680) [`96e936c`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/96e936c34a7e071dfb1e90adffbc3e53814b757b) Thanks [@mglewis](https://github.com/mglewis)! - Apply `images.url_transformations` when deploying a Worker

  `wrangler deploy` and `wrangler versions deploy` now apply the `images.url_transformations` setting to the deployed Worker. The setting is applied after the Worker and its triggers have been deployed. If it can't be applied, the command fails with the reason from the API. Removing `url_transformations` from the configuration leaves the Worker's existing setting in place.

  The setting isn't applied for `--dry-run`, `wrangler versions upload`, or Workers deployed to a dispatch namespace.

### Patch Changes

- [#17063](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/17063) [`6c45ad7`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/6c45ad7ccb87e0de8a8117cf5a547c1d005207a8) Thanks [@sidharthachatterjee](https://github.com/sidharthachatterjee)! - Request the billing scopes when logging in with cf and Wrangler

  Include `billing:write` in the default OAuth scopes of cf and Wrangler so they can create account subscriptions, which is how products such as R2 are enabled on an account. cf also requests `billing:read`. Existing OAuth sessions need a new login to request the scopes.

- [#16947](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16947) [`de6b171`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/de6b171603576fd12afa4f32736c0c0ecb28eeab) Thanks [@umeraamir69](https://github.com/umeraamir69)! - Fix `WRANGLER_LOG_PATH` being ignored when set in `vite.config.ts` after a static import of `@cloudflare/vite-plugin`

  The debug log filepath is now resolved lazily on first write (memoized), matching how `WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS` is read. Setting `process.env.WRANGLER_LOG_PATH` in the Vite config body after importing the plugin now writes logs to the configured path instead of the global default directory.

- Updated dependencies [[`3d228ba`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/3d228ba0f1b155e96f3ab09e1a467937e1d51051)]:
